title: ネットワークプログラミング
subtitle: Network Programming
educationalGoal: Today, many computer systems around the world are connected to each other. In these systems, network operating systems such as Linux and Windows are used. In this course, students will learn about the role of the network operating system (OS) and its basic principles. In addition, students will learn about the implementation methods of socket based network applications.
advice: In this course, students will learn about socket based network programming using Linux. Accordingly, it is desirable that students fully understand the contents learned in "Operating System" before taking this course. In addition, it is desirable that students have sufficient skills about Linux. The following topics are covered: 1. Basic operation and programming of Linux. 2. Network and protocol. 3. Basic knowledge of socket communication. 4. Socket programming 5. Socket programming (concurrent server)
requiredKnowledge: 1. Linux basic operations (command line operation, pipe, redirection). 2. C programming basics. 3. System call programming learned in "Operating System" (open, close, read, write, fork, wait, exec) 4. POSIX thread programming learned in "Operating System" 5. Signal handing learned in "Operating System"

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the principles of a computer network.
Be able to program with the INET domain socket.c
Be able to design and implement network applications.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students with ideal achievement levels will have expert level knowledge and can explain the concepts of network programming. They will also have sufficient skills to design and implement network applications.
achievementLevels.standard: Students with standard achievement levels will have basic level knowledge and can explain the concepts of network programming. They will also have sufficient skills to design and implement simple network applications.

lessons.content: The roles of Kernel and Processes
File Access System calls (open, read, write, close)
Inter Process Communication using socket INET domain socket (TCP, UDP socket)
Details of UDP socket Datagram socket communication System calls (socket, sendto, recvfrom )
Details of TCP socket Stream socket communication System calls (bind, listen, accept, connect, send, recv, getsockname, getpeername)
An implementation example of a simple Web server
Midterm review: understand all learning topics.
Report #1 deadline Take a test (60 min). Answers of the test and their explanations.
Final review: understand all learning topics.
Report #2 deadline Take a test (60 min). Answers and their explanations.
